startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Pages to start crawling from (up to 20). The Actor follows links on the same site.

maxPages.title: Max pages to crawl
maxPages.description: Upper limit of pages crawled on the site (1 to 1000).

checkExternal.title: Check external links
checkExternal.description: Also test links that point to other websites.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per link (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for each link before calling it broken.
